create.name: Dr. Peggy Rowe Ward
create.bio:
Peggy Rowe Ward was ordained as a Dharma teacher by Thich Nhat Hanh and teaches in the Engaged Buddhism of his Plum Village community. With her late husband Larry Ward, she co-founded the Lotus Institute in 1996 with Thay's support and guidance; he also married the couple at Plum Village in France. She now serves as the institute's guiding teacher and one of its two executive directors, and continues the work the couple built together after Larry's death in August 2025.

Her background is in education as much as in meditation. She holds a doctorate in adult education, with doctoral research on dreamwork, and a master's degree in counselling psychology, and she has taught in graduate programmes in social work and psychology. After many years in private practice she now offers consultations centred on spiritual direction. Her teaching draws on movement, writing, art and ritual alongside sitting practice, with an emphasis on helping students find their own creative voice. Each month she leads an online guided meditation and a Dharma talk for the Lotus community, she is the primary teacher of its Anam Cara spiritual mentor training, and with Larry she wrote Love's Garden, a guide to mindful relationships built around couples' stories.

books.title: Love's Garden: A Guide to Mindful Relationships
books.author: Peggy Rowe Ward and Larry Ward
books.description: Real stories from couples of different ages, with commentary and exercises from the two authors on bringing Buddhist practice into a partnership. It sets out practices from the Plum Village tradition that couples can use at any stage of their life together.

courses.title: Continuing the Light
courses.description: An online programme honouring the late Larry Ward: three Thursday evening sessions on bodhisattvas of the Lotus Sutra, followed by a two-day retreat. Sessions are recorded and include a practice workbook.

courses.title: Continuing the Light Weekend Retreat
courses.description: The two closing mornings of the Continuing the Light series, which can be booked on their own. The first day gathers Larry Ward's words and poetry, and the second asks how his teaching is carried on.

courses.title: Lotus Institute Membership
courses.description: Membership of the Lotus community, with a monthly Dharma talk, two guided meditations and two qigong classes, recordings and a weekly practice by email. Higher tiers add the full video library.

courses.title: Enough is a Feast | Dharma Talk with Peggy Rowe Ward
courses.description: A ninety-minute online evening on gratitude, drawing on Thich Nhat Hanh's teachings and Peggy's own stories, with meditation and time for questions. It is recorded for those who register.

Larry Ward (co-founder, co-author, died 19 Aug 2025) is not listed separately; he appears in her bio. Several videos are joint talks with him.
Contact form on the contact page is for speaking or teaching requests.
Base: not published on the Lotus site; a Tricycle obituary (search result, not opened) says the couple lived in Saunderstown, Rhode Island. Not used.

Continuing the Light: the page does not name who leads the sessions (it says 'guided by Larry's teachings'); assumed to be Peggy as guiding teacher. Year inferred as 2027 (Thursday 14 January falls in 2027; the page gives no year). The weekend retreat's product text also mentions 'Saturday, November 7 and Sunday, November 8', which conflicts with the February dates elsewhere; February used.
The institute frames its work partly around 'healing stored trauma'; items built on trauma were left out (see left_out). Her own items are meditation and Dharma teaching.
Photos are from the Lotus about page; the 'red rocks' image is cropped from a photo with Larry ('edited' in the file name).
Book: ISBN from parallax.org product page, not confirmed elsewhere.
